system.description:
At 14th level, choose a natural area, or an area with minimally invasive construction, to be your Protected Land. This area is a number of square miles equal to your level. You become immediately aware of any significant digging, logging, or other harm to your protected area no matter how far you are from it, and whenever you cast @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.8j1p6dsp3qfvjprc]{Tree Stride} or @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.r4yz1k7dlp8lazx5]{Transport Via Plants} you can return to your protected lands no matter how far away you are, even if you are on another planet.

Choosing your protected lands, or changing them, requires 24 hours of preparation. You may only choose or change your protected lands after taking a long rest in a Haven.
